serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Anyreach App is a cloud-hosted SaaS offering for building, deploying, and operating omnichannel conversational AI agents. Anyreach is preparing the offering for direct use by federal agencies in constituent-service and contact-center workflows. An adopting agency will make its own risk decision and issue the applicable authorization for integration into its federal information system.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Anyreach, Inc. public security and privacy Trust Center. It provides compliance posture, controls, resources, subprocessors, and a request-access workflow for restricted materials.
